checkpoint_rule: existing suitable completed fixed iteration50000 else one fresh seed0 50000-step official config training; no quality-based selection
independence: Prior four scenes are development. Config-only capacity inventories and unexecuted fallback list do not use mutant quality. Local inventory found no mutant dataset or checkpoint; WSL baseline storage scan empty.

splits.test: complete official test, metadata/hashes only before freeze
splits.observation_rule: Observation=(exact numeric camera matrix, intrinsics, timestamp). Exclude val if normalized absolute path OR image SHA256 OR observation tuple matches train/test. Then deduplicate val by same keys in original val ordinal order. Raw basename IDs are scoped to split, not globally unique camera identities. Report matrix-only, timestamp-only and basename overlaps separately; these alone are not same observation.
splits.quality_access: no test rendering/error/quality access before SELECTION_FREEZE.json

training.evaluation: disable all training-time test evaluation; assert train-only loader
training.pilot: separate directory; same50000 schedule; through warmup3000 and first deformation/densification; final fresh seed0
training.watchdog: audited external supervisor, fail closed; resource preflight required

level_rule: argmax mean per-view PSNR(RESTORE_FP32_Li)-PSNR(R2); exact tie lowest level; freeze before precision
budget_rule: floor(5*B(R2)/4), physical complete spatial DEFLATE file
selection: minimum bytes among feasible; byte ties R2,M10,M12,M16; else NO_FEASIBLE_POINT and no retroactive selection
numerics: Mean of per-view FP32 metric scalars using torch FP32 mean, stored full Python float; selection comparisons binary64 with no tolerance; exact codes/metadata/dequantization hashes; synthetic scalar reference tolerance eps32*max(1,abs(reference)) only, never for selection
quantizer: unchanged fixed-range helper, global full original xyz FP32 extrema -> binary64 step, divide by step then rint nearest-even clip cast; p>8 little-endian uint16; canonical dequantization FP32
transport: unchanged grid4d-spatial-mixed-v2 ZIP/NPY DEFLATE6 all16 levels; dtype/precision map identifies selected level; no bitpacking
metrics: original PSNR/SSIM; LPIPS_STANDARD_VGG RGB[0,1] normalize=True once eval/inference_mode; PNG evaluation same previous pipeline
scientific_limits: one new scene, correlated views; no significance/BD-rate/novelty/global-optimum claim; no test-driven revision
